answers.question: What changed in the agent's traces after you wrote your instructions? Give one claim as an example.
answers.answer: Before, the agent noticed that part of the claim wasn't stated but still counted it as true. After, it treated that part as a fact that needed checking and when it couldn't confirm it, it answered "doesn't say".

answers.question: Answer
answers.answer: For example, the claim "The former leader of the school of Soviet and Russian humorists's youngest son is the head of Moscow Satyricon Theatre." Both runs used 6 lookups and read the Arkady Raikin and Konstantin Raikin articles. Before, the agent answered "supported" even though it noticed "youngest son" was "not explicitly stated". After, it treated "youngest son" as a fact that needed checking. Nothing contradicted it but nothing confirmed it either, so it answered "doesn't say" which matches the dataset's label.
